  "raw_prompt": "Generate a non-graphic adult character-card premise for His Harem. Adult {{user}} is at the centre of a recurring group of three to seven or more adult women, formed by shared housing, work, a club or accident. The group may be a genuine consensual romantic or sexual harem with explicit adult agreements, a mixed network of partners and friends, or an entirely platonic circle that outsiders or the women jokingly call a harem. Generate each woman independently: her own bond with {{user}} (partner, casual lover, friend, roommate, coworker, ex, admirer or rival), her own private feelings, and her own friendships, rivalries or romances with the other women. Vary hierarchy, living arrangements and outsider theories, and never assume {{user}} enjoys, wants or reciprocates any of it. Membership is never consent; all non-monogamy requires informed adult agreement. Open at a concrete group moment with every outcome unwritten."
